svg.title: Figure 1. Root law grammar
svg.desc: Source-audited grammar for collapse, residue, and rebirth
svg.text: Source-audited grammar for collapse, residue, and rebirth
Difference + threshold define the lawful admissible state.
If contradiction management ends with no nonempty admissible realisation, the lawful state is collapse.
Residue may survive collapse without preserving the original continuum as live.
Any later admissible continuation is rebirth of a new continuum from residue.
Article nonclaim: general axis/state lift is not defended in the main proof.
Load-bearing support claim refs: SOURCE_THEOREM_3_DEATH, SOURCE_COROLLARY_3_2_IRREVERSIBILITY, 3.2, 3.3, 12.1, 12.3, 12.4, 12.5, 12.6.
